title: New comedy from Globo Studios premieres in September
seoTitle: New comedy from Globo Studios premieres in September
subtitle: Rodrigo Sant'Anna creates and stars as the nanny who decides to take a vacation
excerpt: The new comedy 'Socorro! Minha Babá Tirou Férias', created and starring Rodrigo Sant'Anna, arrives on Telecine in September, bringing humor about the daily life of.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The release of "Socorro! Minha Babá Tirou Férias" stirs up the cultural agenda with the announcement of the new comedy from Globo Studios, set to premiere on September 25 in the Telecine catalog. The film arrives on streaming and premium TV, generating curiosity about the plot that blends humor and family issues.

What is the comedy "Socorro! Minha Babá Tirou Férias" about?

Produced by Globo Studios' Film Nucleus, the work was created and written by Rodrigo Sant'Anna, Marcelo Gonçalves, and Sabrina Garcia, with direction by Cris D'Amato. The production team includes Érika da Matta, Betina Paulon, and artistic supervision by Patrícia Pedrosa.

Who are the main characters?

Rodrigo Sant'Anna plays two central figures: Socorro, the nanny, and Helena, her workaholic automotive engineer boss who balances career and children. Helena relies on the nanny to care for Pedro and Enzo, played by Don Estarneck and Ravi Welsh. When Socorro decides to take a vacation, Helena must face domestic chaos and seek support from her ex-husband Maurício (Dudu Azevedo) and her mother Celita (Solange Couto).

Story context and inspiration

The tension between Helena and Socorro stems from Sant'Anna's own life experience, having been raised by his biological mother and a godmother who cared for him while his mother worked. The screenwriter states that this experience served as a basis to portray love in different forms and the importance of caregivers in daily life.

Cast and special appearances

In addition to Sant'Anna, the film brings together Guilherme Fontes, Lola Fanucchi, Luellem de Castro, and features a special appearance by Angélica. The ensemble cast expands the range of characters revolving around the family dynamic.

Schedule and exhibition platforms

The premiere takes place on Friday, September 25, in the Telecine catalog, accessible via Globoplay, Prime Video, and cable operators. On television, the first screening will be on Telecine Premium, Saturday, 26, at 10 PM, followed by Telecine Pipoca, Sunday, 27, at 8 PM.

With information from TELA VIVA News.
